name: Image Optimizer
author: Misty
overview: Image Optimizer makes collision-safe optimized copies of up to 64 JPEG, PNG, or WebP images with approachable quality and size presets.
capabilities: Optimize up to 64 images at once
Limit output dimensions with quality-focused presets
Show per-file outcomes and total space saved
permissions: Write access beside originals or in Downloads
getting_started: Select JPEG, PNG, or WebP files in Files.
Choose quality, maximum dimension, and destination.
Optimize copies and reveal the outputs.
changelog: v0.3.0 - Initial production release with source preservation, cancellation cleanup, collision-safe naming, and bundled FFmpeg.
